title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
summary: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.

title: Bitget clarifies $388M in assets affected by security breach
summary: The Bitget breach announced on Thursday affected about $35 million more than previously reported, based on an analysis of assets on Zcash and TRON.

title: Researchers Publish 'Zcash-Style' Design for Private Bitcoin Transfers
summary: The Shielded Bitcoin spec hides senders, receivers and amounts, but leaves how BTC enters and exits the system to a later paper.

title: Researchers propose Zcash-style private Bitcoin transfers without a soft fork
summary: Shielded Bitcoin would use zero-knowledge proofs and encrypted notes to hide transaction details without changing Bitcoin consensus, but researchers have raised questions about anonymity and quantum resistance.
